set(libdivsufsort_SOURCES
    libdivsufsort/lib/divsufsort.c
    libdivsufsort/lib/sssort.c
    libdivsufsort/lib/trsort.c
    libdivsufsort/lib/utils.c)

add_library(libdivsufsort STATIC ${libdivsufsort_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(libdivsufsort PUBLIC
	libdivsufsort/android_include)
target_include_directories(libdivsufsort PRIVATE
	libdivsufsort/include)
target_compile_definitions(libdivsufsort PRIVATE
    HAVE_CONFIG_H=1)

add_library(libdivsufsort64 STATIC ${libdivsufsort_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(libdivsufsort64 PUBLIC
	libdivsufsort/android_include)
target_include_directories(libdivsufsort64 PRIVATE
	libdivsufsort/include)
target_compile_definitions(libdivsufsort64 PRIVATE
    HAVE_CONFIG_H=1 BUILD_DIVSUFSORT64)

add_library(libbsdiff STATIC
	bsdiff/brotli_compressor.cc
	bsdiff/bsdiff.cc
	bsdiff/bz2_compressor.cc
	bsdiff/compressor_buffer.cc
	bsdiff/diff_encoder.cc
	bsdiff/endsley_patch_writer.cc
	bsdiff/logging.cc
	bsdiff/patch_writer.cc
	bsdiff/patch_writer_factory.cc
	bsdiff/split_patch_writer.cc
	bsdiff/suffix_array_index.cc)
add_library(libbspatch STATIC
	bsdiff/brotli_decompressor.cc
	bsdiff/bspatch.cc
	bsdiff/bz2_decompressor.cc
	bsdiff/buffer_file.cc
	bsdiff/decompressor_interface.cc
	bsdiff/extents.cc
	bsdiff/extents_file.cc
	bsdiff/file.cc
	bsdiff/logging.cc
	bsdiff/memory_file.cc
	bsdiff/patch_reader.cc
	bsdiff/sink_file.cc
	bsdiff/utils.cc)

target_include_directories(libbsdiff PUBLIC
	bsdiff/.. bsdiff/include)
target_link_libraries(libbsdiff PRIVATE
    PkgConfig::libbrotlienc
    BZip2::BZip2
    libdivsufsort
    libdivsufsort64)
target_include_directories(libbspatch PUBLIC
	bsdiff/.. bsdiff/include)
target_link_libraries(libbspatch PRIVATE
    PkgConfig::libbrotlidec
    BZip2::BZip2)

add_executable(bsdiff
	bsdiff/bsdiff_arguments.cc
	bsdiff/bsdiff_main.cc)
add_executable(bspatch
	bsdiff/bspatch_main.cc)

target_link_libraries(bsdiff PRIVATE libbsdiff)
target_link_libraries(bspatch PRIVATE libbspatch)
